purpose: Versioned country-to-field registry for the World Relational Atlas. It separates Tim/Potatoverse axis assignments from empirical institutions while preserving overlap, uncertainty, chronology and provenance.
boundary: North, West, East and South are project interpretive fields, not borders, sovereignty, citizenship, ethnicity, consent or legal alignment. Center is a convergence/hinge arena rather than a fifth territorial bloc. Countries may overlap fields. Empirical memberships remain separate evidence layers.
north_semantic_rule: Project North is one typed meaning of North. Geographic true north, magnetic north, Arctic geography, Nordic culture/institutions, the Denmark-Greenland Realm relation, comparative spiritual North and North-of-North meta-orientation remain distinct layers connected through data/north-axis-semantic-contract.json.

brics.label: BRICS
brics.meaning: empirical BRICS backbone; visually coupled to East but not identical to it

evidence_model.explicit: Directly recovered Tim country-list or field statement.
evidence_model.recovered: Repeated or structurally consistent project formulation recovered from conversation/archive material.
evidence_model.corroborated: Project assignment that also maps onto a strong observable relationship without treating that institution as the cause of the assignment.
evidence_model.provisional: Current analytical hypothesis or newly suggested assignment not yet backed by a recovered project statement.
evidence_model.unknown: Insufficient project evidence; do not color by inference alone.

north.symbolic_function: ascent / order / development / memory / civilization / Father / Throne
north.notes: Recovered core runs Canada/Greenland through the North Atlantic, Scandinavia and continental Europe toward Ukraine and Türkiye. Official Arctic Council, Nordic, NATO and EU structures strongly corroborate parts of this topology without defining it. Russia is the clearest proof that physical Arctic geography and current project-North membership are not identical. The project Denmark -> Greenland -> North Gate activation chain is separately typed as project canon in the North semantic contract and must not overwrite Greenlandic self-government or the empirical constitutional relation.
north.confidence: high for named 2026 arc; mixed at UK, Russia and Mesopotamian edges

west.status: developed but broader and less institutionally bounded than North
west.symbolic_function: American / Israeli institutional power, finance, military-technology, disruption and visible-system field
west.notes: Recovered West is U.S.-centered and Atlantic/American. South America was described as West-primary unless specifically pulled toward East/North. MERCOSUR demonstrates that real integration can cross the project West/East hinge. APEC likewise shows West, East and South economies occupying one economic forum.
west.confidence: high at USA/Israel; medium across wider Americas and Indo-Pacific overlaps

east.status: developed relational field; explicitly not synonymous with BRICS
east.notes: Recovered East is Eurasian/Asian plus selected BRICS-linked nodes. SCO is a stronger empirical Eurasian comparator than BRICS because its ten members cluster around China, Russia, Central Asia, India, Pakistan, Iran and Belarus. BRICS remains broader and officially frames itself as Global South coordination rather than an Eastern alliance.
east.confidence: high at China/Russia/India and recovered Asian assignments; medium where BRICS is only corroborating context

south.notes: Recovered material points toward an Australia/New Zealand/Pacific and Indian-Ocean/southern-African maritime field. SADC provides a real 16-state southern-African integration layer; Pacific Islands Forum and APEC provide real Pacific/Asia-Pacific relational structures. These corroborate a southern-maritime topology without proving Timic membership. Papua New Guinea remains provisional until a direct Tim assignment is recovered.
south.confidence: medium at Australia/New Zealand and southern-maritime logic; provisional for Papua New Guinea and wider African expansion

center.status: convergence arena, not a territorial quadrant
center.symbolic_function: roots / cradle / promise / covenant / lion / rivers / old-source convergence
center.notes: Recovered project language repeatedly places the Middle East as the middle where multiple fields meet: Mesopotamia/Iraq as Father/root/promise, Israel as Children/covenant and project-West, Iran as Lion and project-East, Egypt as civilizational hinge, Türkiye as North endpoint/bridge, and Saudi Arabia as West + Islam + oil + Center. GCC is useful empirical context inside the Gulf but does not define Center. Center should render as a convergence overlay, not as a fifth sovereign bloc.
center.confidence: high for the convergence concept and Iraq/Israel/Iran/Egypt motifs; medium-to-provisional for wider Gulf extension

BRICS.interpretive_use: Global South coordination; useful East/South-South comparator but never an automatic East assignment.

NATO.interpretive_use: Explains part of the dense North/West security graph, but defines neither project field.

EU.interpretive_use: Institutional backbone inside European North; North also contains non-EU states, candidates and territories.

ARCTIC_COUNCIL.interpretive_use: Real circumpolar geography crossing project North, West and East.

NORDIC.interpretive_use: Strong real institutional kernel inside project North.

SCO.interpretive_use: Strong Eurasian comparator for project East.

ASEAN.interpretive_use: Observable Southeast Asian regional layer crossing project East/South boundaries.

APEC.interpretive_use: Demonstrates that Asia-Pacific economic integration crosses West/East/South field boundaries.

PACIFIC_ISLANDS_FORUM.interpretive_use: Strong Pacific relational comparator for project South.

SADC.interpretive_use: Real southern-African integration layer; prevents flattening all Africa into South.

GCC.interpretive_use: Real Gulf coordination layer inside the wider project Center arena.

African_Union_regions.interpretive_use: Use five-region African geography to keep real geography distinct from project fields.

MERCOSUR.interpretive_use: South American integration crossing the project West/East hinge.

bridge_zones.note: Bridge zones are analytically more informative than forcing mutually exclusive quadrants. They describe overlapping relationships, not territorial boundaries.

classification_rule: Prefer recovered explicit Tim assignments; preserve overlaps; attach confidence/provenance; mark inferred or developing assignments as provisional; use real-world institutions only as corroborating relationship layers, never as automatic project-field assignments.
